requirements_summary: Goal: customer-support agent + ticket-deflection RAG. Must support live search over 20M+ help articles/tickets, embeddings refresh daily, top-5 rerank quality (MRR@5 target >= 0.68). Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end query <= 150ms for single-turn support lookup; cost target <= $0.005/query (end-to-end). Need VPC/private deployment with KMS, audit logs, and SSO. Prefer hybrid ANN+reranker architecture to keep recall high while reranking only top 50 candidates. POC will validate indexing scale, p95 latency with batching disabled for interactive flows, and reranker accuracy/CPU+GPU footprint.
notes: 2026-02-24 — Demo with Maya, Diego, and product: walked through Redwood routing + Dedicated pool. Customer impressed by automatic KV caching but concerned about reranker latency at scale.
Customer quote: 'We can tolerate occasional 350-400ms background transforms, but the agent UI needs <150ms for first-pass answers.'

They run multi-tenant SaaS for SMBs — average ticket size 900 tokens after enrichment; knowledge base ~18–25M documents (tickets, KB articles, transcripts). Expect daily delta of ~200k new/updated documents.
Current stack: Postgres primary metadata, S3 cold store, in-house ANN on EC2 for search (high ops burden). Evaluating replacement to reduce infra cost and improve tail latency.
Metrics they care about for POC: recall@5, MRR@5, p50/p95 latency, cost per query, sync time for daily embedding refresh, index rebuild time for 1M docs.
Security asks: SOC2 attestation, SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, audit log streaming to Splunk, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for EU tenant data.

POC scope agreed: ingest 20M doc subset (mixed tickets + articles), run ANN index + embed using Redwood-verified emb model, run small transformer reranker (quantized) to rerank top 50 -> top 5. 2-week evaluation window.
POC success criteria: p95 query end-to-end <= 150ms (agent path), MRR@5 >= 0.68 vs baseline 0.55, cost per query <= $0.005 at 10 QPS sustained, index warmup <3 hours after daily refresh.
